proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6770.1 *dhāgga gives regional dhāgā thread, explicitly Jaunsari dhāgā in the addenda. Jaunsari daga and Mewari dāga fit the voiced thread family with absent aspiration retained as a local qualification. The deeper *dhārga/*dharga revision in the addenda and internal Indo-Aryan transmission remain open. Exact response: dāga.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1577 indradhanuṣ means rainbow. Mewari indradanuś preserves the full learned compound, with deaspiration and final sibilant articulation retained. It is linked as learned Sanskrit vocabulary with intermediate Indo-Aryan transmission open. Exact response: indradanuś.
